//: The repository root became an ESM package when Vite arrived (root package.json, "type": "module"), which silently turned every plain .js in the repo into ESM — including these two CommonJS checkers, which actions/github-script loads with require(). Node resolves module type from the NEAREST package.json, so this file scopes .github/scripts/ back to CommonJS. Without it the PR and issue description checks fail at load with "checkPrDescription is not a function", in CI, on every pull request.
name: odysseus-github-scripts
